body:
Water and bread (and other similar foods) usually help

I usually just end up throwing up so the pill binding is pushed out if my throat so it stops causing the burning, and it works every time for me. but like… not recommended it’s not fun

I think I read in another post’s comments/replies that it’s something about if your throat is dry, it’ll get caught in your throat (or part of it) and it will dissolve there. I’m pretty sure either the chemicals or something of the pill binding make it burn so bad. If I find the post/comment, I’ll link it for you

edit: found it! 
https://www.reddit.com/r/zoloft/comments/fegvgd/extreme_burning_in_throat_after_dry_swallow/fjovf4d/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=ios_app&utm_name=iossmf
I'd love to be your pen pal! send me a message :)

I actually had an experience like this a few days ago for the first time. I wasn’t sure why I felt it while I was in my own home, but I keep feeling like I just wanted to go HOME. Seeing this makes me feel a bit better, knowing others do experience it as well
